_comment: Snapshot for reference only. R2's _manifest/manifest.json is authoritative. Regenerated on every ingest.

anonymisation.timestamps: Scaled by an undisclosed factor >1 and shifted to start 2000-01-01. These are anonymised mission time, NOT UTC.
anonymisation.values: Min-max normalised to [0,1] within each channel group.
anonymisation.names: Missions, subsystems, channels, telecommands and units are renamed and renumbered.

reference_hints.resampling_method: zero-order hold (forward fill); never linear or Fourier
